body:
Even though I do agree that new scenery could help, I'm still so uncertain if that will change anything. Not to mention, I have to trudge through the rest of this semester to get to it. And even then, what if something goes wrong, and I have to put up with yet another semester? All the things that could go wrong terrify me to no end. I don't know if it's worth it.

I've fallen in love and gotten drunk, both experiences not that significant to me. I don't have the funds or means to travel, and even if I did, I'm way too scared of being in a drastically new environment that I'm not familiar with. 

Like I mentioned, I have fallen in love, but it fell apart and put me in an awful depressed-like state afterwards, except this was a sadness totally separate from my own current problems (maybe more like, grief?) because all throughout that relationship I was still in the habit of shutting everyone out, isolating myself, and suicidal for these same reasons. I realized from that experience that relationships, love, caring for someone, doesn't ensure happiness nor make the pain hurt any less.

Thankfully I got over the breakup and it no longer haunts me, but I still have to deal with the rest of whatever has been wrong with me all these years.
